objective: Prove: (1) in any system the knots, ties and fixed points are the minimal constrained sets, and two knots sharing a distinction e compose like cycles when their union without e is constrained; (2) for a law with a Mal'tsev polymorphism, every system satisfies circuit elimination exactly when every subalgebra of the polymorphism algebra with at least two elements has a unique maximal congruence (by rectangularity a circuit fixes its shared variable modulo a congruence, and a failure needs two congruences whose composition is total), with corollaries for fields, cyclic groups of prime-power order and finite groups (every subgroup has a unique maximal normal subgroup: S3 composes like cycles; A4, Z6, Z2xZ2, D4 and Q8 do not); (3) a Boolean law composes like cycles exactly when it is affine, and composes its knots like cycles exactly when it is affine or bijunctive, through Post's lattice and explicit hubs; (4) a hub criterion (two knots sharing e meet at a hub when every e-fibre of one meets every e-fibre of the other), with the colouring law and the isolated-value laws as cases; Tseitin knots are bonds and gauge knots are cycles.
status: Proved by KNOT-CIRCUITS-20261020-001B-P001 (prose; Post's lattice cited; exhaustive and randomized checks). Knots and ties are a system's minimal constrained sets (relative to each variable's range), and where circuit elimination holds they are the circuits of a matroid. A law with a Mal'tsev polymorphism composes like cycles exactly when every subalgebra of its polymorphism algebra with at least two elements has a unique maximal congruence (rectangularity: a circuit fixes its shared variable modulo a congruence, and a failure needs two congruences composing to the total relation); affine field laws do, and a group's coset law does exactly when every subgroup has a unique maximal normal subgroup (Z_{p^k}, S3 and D_p do; Z6, Z2xZ2, A4, D4, Q8, Dic3 and Z12 do not). A Boolean law composes like cycles exactly when affine, and composes knots like cycles exactly when affine or bijunctive; explicit pp-formulas give knot hubs for the eight negation-twists of 1-in-3 that the census search missed. Two knots sharing only e form a hub exactly when every e-fibre of one meets every e-fibre of the other. Tseitin knots are bonds and gauge knots are cycles. Open: whether every law that has knots and composes them like cycles is Mal'tsev (Boolean: yes).
title: Proof: Mal'tsev laws compose knots like cycles exactly when no distinction splits in two; the Boolean classification
